10932-over-the-pass.title: Over The Pass
10932-over-the-pass.creator: Unknown
10932-over-the-pass.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In all the region about the Galeria Pass the silence of the dry Arizona air seemed luminous and eternal. Whoever climbed to the crotch of that V, cut jagged against the sky for distances yet unreckoned by tourist folders, might have the reward of pitching the tents of his imagination at the gateway of the clouds.

61951-the-raiders-of-saturn-s-ring.title: The Raiders Of Saturn S Ring
61951-the-raiders-of-saturn-s-ring.creator: Unknown
61951-the-raiders-of-saturn-s-ring.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Bringing in seeds and cattle and hogs! Even bumble-bees to pollinate the flowers! Ain't no dirty, fuzzy Callistan devils gonna take Titan away from us now! We made us a little heaven, here, with the sweat of our brows!

arxiv-2003-07945.title: Co-Optimizing Performance and Memory Footprint Via Integrated CPU/GPU Memory Management, an Implementation on Autonomous Driving Platform
arxiv-2003-07945.creator: Soroush Bateni * , Zhendong Wang * , Yuankun Zhu, Yang Hu, and Cong Liu
arxiv-2003-07945.description: Abstract Cutting-edge embedded system applications, such as self-driving cars and unmanned drone software, are reliant on integrated CPU/GPU platforms for their DNNs-driven workload, such as perception and other highly parallel components. In this work, we set out to explore the hidden performance implication of GPU memory management methods of integrated CPU/GPU architecture.

arxiv-2109-05913.title: did2s : Two-Stage Difference-in-Differences
arxiv-2109-05913.creator: by Kyle Butts, John Gardner
arxiv-2109-05913.description: Abstract Recent work has highlighted the difficulties of estimating difference-in-differences models when the treatment is adopted at different times for different units. This article introduces the R package did2s which implements the estimator introduced in Gardner 2021 . The article provides an approachable review of the underlying econometric theory and introduces the syntax for the function did2s .

arxiv-2201-06876.title: Syntax-based data augmentation for Hungarian-English machine translation
arxiv-2201-06876.creator: Attila Nagy, Patrick Nanys, Balázs Frey Konrád, Bence Bial, Judit Ács
arxiv-2201-06876.description: Abstract We train Transformer-based neural machine translation models for Hungarian-English and English-Hungarian using the Hunglish2 corpus. Our best models achieve a BLEU score of 40.0 on Hungarian-English and 33.4 on English-Hungarian. Furthermore, we present results on an ongoing work about syntax-based augmentation for neural machine translation. Both our code and models are publicly available 1 1 1 https://github.com/attilanagy234/syntax-augmentation-nmt .

arxiv-2203-00065.title: Self-Repelling Elastic Manifolds with Low Dimensional Range Thanks: CM was partially supported by Simons Foundation grant 513424.
arxiv-2203-00065.creator: Carl Mueller, Eyal Neuman
arxiv-2203-00065.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Carl Mueller, Eyal Neuman. We consider self-repelling elastic manifolds with a domain [ − N , N ] d ∩ ℤ d [-N,N]^{d}\cap\mathbb{Z}^{d} , that take values in ℝ D \mathbb{R}^{D} . Our main result states that when the dimension of the domain is d = 2 d=2 and the dimension of the range is D = 1 D=1 , the effective radius R N R_{N} of the manifold is approximately N 4 / 3 N^{4/3} .

arxiv-2203-05909.title: Future stability of self-gravitating dust balls in an expanding universe
arxiv-2203-05909.creator: S Beheshti, M Normann, JA Valiente Kroon
arxiv-2203-05909.description: Abstract We consider a system representing self-gravitating balls of dust in an expanding Universe. It is demonstrated that one can prescribe data for such a system at infinity and evolve it backward in time without the development of shocks or singularities.

arxiv-2210-12509.title: Cut-and-Approximate: 3D Shape Reconstruction from Planar Cross-sections with Deep Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2210-12509.creator: Azimkhon A. Ostonov
arxiv-2210-12509.description: Abstract Current methods for 3D object reconstruction from a set of planar cross-sections still struggle to capture detailed topology or require a considerable number of cross-sections. In this paper, we present, to the best of our knowledge the first 3D shape reconstruction network to solve this task which additionally uses orthographic projections of the shape.

arxiv-2305-16599.title: Bridging the Domain Gaps in Context Representations for k k -Nearest Neighbor Neural Machine Translation
arxiv-2305-16599.creator: Zhiwei Cao, Baosong Yang, Huan Lin, Suhang Wu, Xiangpeng Wei, Dayiheng Liu, Jun Xie, Min Zhang, Jinsong Su
arxiv-2305-16599.description: Abstract k k -Nearest neighbor machine translation ( k k NN-MT) has attracted increasing attention due to its ability to non-parametrically adapt to new translation domains. By using an upstream NMT model to traverse the downstream training corpus, it is equipped with a datastore containing vectorized key-value pairs, which are retrieved during inference to benefit translation.

arxiv-2405-14169.title: Towards Transferable Attacks Against Vision-LLMs in Autonomous Driving with Typography
arxiv-2405-14169.creator: Nhat Chung, Sensen Gao, Tuan-Anh Vu, Jie Zhang, Aishan Liu, Yun Lin, Jin Song Dong, Qing Guo
arxiv-2405-14169.description: Abstract Vision-Large-Language-Models (Vision-LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into autonomous driving (AD) systems due to their advanced visual-language reasoning capabilities, targeting the perception, prediction, planning, and control mechanisms. However, Vision-LLMs have demonstrated susceptibilities against various types of adversarial attacks, which would compromise their reliability and safety.

arxiv-2407-04148.title: DYNAMIC PROBLEM OF A POWER-LAW GRADED HALF-PLANE AND AN ASSOCIATED CARLEMAN PROBLEM FOR TWO FUNCTIONS
arxiv-2407-04148.creator: Y.A. Antipov
arxiv-2407-04148.description: Abstract A steady state plane problem of an inhomogeneous half-plane subjected to a load running along the boundary at subsonic speed is analyzed. The Lame coefficients and the density of the half-plane are assumed to be power functions of depth.

arxiv-2408-15989.title: Software Solutions for Newcomers’ Onboarding in Software Projects: A Systematic Literature Review
arxiv-2408-15989.creator: Italo Santos, Katia Romero Felizardo, Igor Steinmacher, Marco A. Gerosa
arxiv-2408-15989.description: Abstract [Context] Newcomers joining an unfamiliar software project face numerous barriers; therefore, effective onboarding is essential to help them engage with the team and develop the behaviors, attitudes, and skills needed to excel in their roles. However, onboarding can be a lengthy, costly, and error-prone process.

arxiv-2411-11222.title: The Sound of Water: Inferring Physical Properties from Pouring Liquids
arxiv-2411-11222.creator: Piyush Bagad, Makarand Tapaswi, IIIT Hyderabad, Cees G. M. Snoek, Andrew Zisserman, https://bpiyush.github.io/pouring-water-website
arxiv-2411-11222.description: Abstract We study the connection between audio-visual observations and the underlying physics of a mundane yet intriguing everyday activity: pouring liquids . Given only the sound of liquid pouring into a container, our objective is to automatically infer physical properties such as the liquid level, the shape and size of the container, the pouring rate and the time to fill.

arxiv-2501-07685.title: Adaptive sequential Monte Carlo for structured cross validation in Bayesian hierarchical models
arxiv-2501-07685.creator: Geonhee Han, Graduate School of Arts, Sciences, Columbia University, Department of Statistics, Department of Political Science, Columbia University
arxiv-2501-07685.description: Abstract Importance sampling (IS) is commonly used for cross validation (CV) in Bayesian models, because it only involves reweighting existing posterior draws without needing to re-estimate the model by re-running Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). For hierarchical models, standard IS can be unreliable; the out-of-sample generalization hypothesis may involve structured case-deletion schemes which significantly alter the posterior geometry.

arxiv-2505-02295.title: Landau damping in mixed hyperbolic-kinetic systems and thick sprays
arxiv-2505-02295.creator: D. Bian, B. Després, V. Fournet, E. Grenier
arxiv-2505-02295.description: Abstract Abstract This article is devoted to the study of a model of thick sprays which combines the Vlasov equation for the particles and the barotropic compressible Euler equations to describe the fluid, coupled through the gradient of the pressure of the fluid.

arxiv-2506-00144.title: Three fast-spinning medium-sized Hilda asteroids uncovered by TESS Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2506-00144.creator: Nóra Takács, Csaba Kiss, Róbert Szakáts, Emese Plachy, Csilla E. Kalup, Gyula M. Szabó, László Molnár, Krisztián Sárneczky, Róbert Szabó, Attila Bódi, András Pál
arxiv-2506-00144.description: Abstract Hilda asteroids, which orbit in a 3:2 resonance with Jupiter, serve as key indicators of dynamical processes in the early solar system. Their spin rates, an important probe of these mechanisms, can constrain their density and collisional evolution, offering valuable insights into their origin.

arxiv-2506-12631.title: Solitary waves in the complementary generalized ABS model
arxiv-2506-12631.creator: Avinash Khare, Fred Cooper, John F. Dawson, Avadh Saxena
arxiv-2506-12631.description: Abstract We obtain exact solutions of the nonlinear Dirac equation in 1+1 dimension of the form Ψ ⁡ ( x , t ) = Φ ⁡ ( x ) ​ e − i ​ ω ​ t \Psi(x,t)=\Phi(x){\rm e}^{-{\rm i}\omega t} where the nonlinear interactions are a combination of vector-vector and scalar-scalar interactions with the interaction Lagrangian given by L

arxiv-2506-13139.title: Random Matrix Theory for Deep Learning: Beyond Eigenvalues of Linear Models
arxiv-2506-13139.creator: Zhenyu Liao, Michael W. Mahoney
arxiv-2506-13139.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhenyu Liao, Michael W. Mahoney. 1
Introduction

Modern applications of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) aim to extract insights from high-dimensional datasets using over-parameterized ML models such as Deep Neural Networks (DNNs). Data are typically represented as high-dimensional random vectors (of dimension
p
); numerous random vectors can be arranged into large random matrices (of size
p\times n
); and these can further be arranged into tensors.

plaw-114-266-2016.creator: United States Congress
plaw-114-266-2016.description: Public Law 114-266 (2016): An act to require a regional strategy to address the threat posed by Boko Haram.

plos-pone-0007191.creator: Rosanna Capparelli, Alessandra Romanelli, Marco Iannaccone et al.
plos-pone-0007191.description: PLOS ONE research article. Temporins are antimicrobial peptides secreted by the granular glands of the European red frog ( Rana temporaria ). They are 10–14 amino acid long polypeptides active prevalently against gram positive bacteria. This study shows that a synthetic temporin B analogue (TB-YK), acquire

pmc-11329713.title: A protein O-GlcNAc glycosyltransferase regulates the antioxidative response in Yersinia pestis
pmc-11329713.creator: Shiyang Cao, Tong Wang, Yifan Ren, Gengshan Wu, Yuan Zhang, Yafang Tan, Yazhou Zhou, Hongyan Chen, Yu Zhang, Yajun Song, Ruifu Yang, Zongmin Du
pmc-11329713.description: Post-translational addition of O-linked N-acetylglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) to proteins is commonly associated with a variety of stress responses and cellular processes in eukaryotes, but its potential roles in bacteria are unclear. Here, we show that protein HmwC acts as an O-GlcNAc transferase (OGT) responsible for O-GlcNAcylation of multiple proteins in Yersinia pestis, a flea-borne pathogen responsible for plague.

pmc-11600940.title: DNA methylation analysis of peripheral blood mononuclear cells in diagnosing breast cancer from benign breast lesions
pmc-11600940.creator: Ying Zhang, Lei Cheng
pmc-11600940.description: BackgroundWith the increasing incidence of breast lesions, the differential diagnosis between benign lesions and breast cancer (BCa) has become a big challenge. Host peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) could undergo changes in DNA methylation upon disease progression. However, the clinical value of DNA methylation of PBMCs in differentiating benign lesions and BCa is still unclear.

pmc-11608342.title: Rib fracture characteristics increasing the risk of hemothorax: a multicenter study
pmc-11608342.creator: Sercan Aydın, Seda Kahraman Aydın, Barış Gülmez, Süleyman Gökalp Güneş, Önder Kavurmacı, Ömer Faruk Dadaş
pmc-11608342.description: The precise assessment of hemothorax risk resulting from a rib fracture is not feasible. CT images, patient characteristics, and clinical experience are utilized in daily practice to assess risk intuitively. This study aimed to identify specific markers on CT images that can predict the risk of hemothorax.

pmc-12474366.title: Metabolic Profiling, Tissue Distribution, and Tolerance Assessment of Bopu Powder in Laying Hens Following Long-Term Dietary Administration
pmc-12474366.creator: Hongting Wang, Xinhao Wang, Jiaxin Xu, Zihui Yang, Zhen Dong, Jianguo Zeng, Hua Liu, Chongshan Dai, Jichang Li
pmc-12474366.description: Simple SummaryThis study assessed the safety and metabolism of Bopu Powder—a herbal veterinary product—in laying hens following 56 days of dietary supplementation. Its major alkaloids, protopine and allocryptopine, were extensively metabolized. Residual levels were low and limited to the liver and kidneys, with occasional detection in eggs only at the highest dose (500 mg/kg).

pmc-12511445.title: Amplified copper ion interference and immunomodulation using self-thermophoretic nanomotors to treat refractory implant-associated biofilm infections
pmc-12511445.creator: Liuliang He, Qiyong Pan, Mingfei Li, Zhichao Wang, Long Wang, Chi Zhang, Zhi-Hao Wang, Jinjin Shi, Daifeng Li
pmc-12511445.description: Orthopedic implant-associated biofilm infections (IABIs) are refractory to elimination because of the dense biofilm formation and local immunosuppressive microenvironment. Herein, we propose a copper-based therapeutic strategy to treat IABIs. Initially, the Janus bisphere nanostructure is fabricated using mesoporous silicon nanoparticle (MSN) with gold nanoparticle. Subsequently, copper peroxide (CP) nanodots are encapsulated within the MSN to form the final nanomotor Motor@CP.

pmc-12764021.title: COVID-19 vaccine attitude, vaccine literacy, and religious attitudes: a cross-sectional study in Turkiye
pmc-12764021.creator: Filiz Taş, Gülhan Yiğitalp
pmc-12764021.description: BackgroundThe relationship between COVID-19 vaccine attitude and vaccine literacy and religious attitude has been shown in studies. The purpose of the present study was to determine the relationship between COVID-19 vaccine attitude, vaccine literacy and religious attitudes and the factors affecting vaccine attitudes.

pmc-13024612.title: GAN-Based Cross-Modality Brain MRI Synthesis: Paired Versus Unpaired Training and Comparison with Diffusion and Transformer Models
pmc-13024612.creator: Behnam Kiani Kalejahi, Sebelan Danishvar, Mohammad Javad Rajabi
pmc-13024612.description: Incomplete or faulty MRI sequences are common in clinical practice and can impair AI-based analyses that rely on complete multi-contrast data. The relative effectiveness of classical generative adversarial networks (GANs) versus modern diffusion and transformer-based models for clinically usable MRI synthesis remains unclear. This study evaluates cross-modality MRI synthesis using the BraTS 2019 brain tumour dataset, focusing on T1-to-T2 translation.

pmc-13145445.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1518 BLOOD-BRAIN BARRIER DISRUPTION IN PATIENTS WITH INCIDENTAL WHITE MATTER HYPERINTENSITIES
pmc-13145445.creator: Richard Leigh, Sarvin Sasannia, Shimeng Wang, Jinwei Zhang, Jerry Prince, Lew Becker, Dhananjay Vaidya, Peter van Zijl, Linda Knutsson, Paul Nyquist
pmc-13145445.description: Background and aimsIncidental white matter hyperintensities (WMH) are thought to be part of normal aging. Blood-brain barrier disruption (BBBD) is known to be part of the pathogenesis of WMH in patients with a history of cerebrovascular disease. However the role of BBBD in the development of incidental WMH has not been studied.

pmc-13201996.title: Towards a feature-based regulatory benchmark for user-centred SaMD design in cancer care
pmc-13201996.creator: Saba Kheirinejad, Christopher L Brett, Robert L Davis, David L Schwartz, Arash Shaban-Nejad
pmc-13201996.description: Software as a medical device (SaMD) is increasingly central to cancer care, yet current regulatory frameworks from the International Medical Device Regulators, the US Food and Drug Administration and the European Medical Device Regulation lack clear premarket standards for evaluating usability, accessibility and emotional/cultural appropriateness for intended users.

pmc-13323407.title: Association Between Edmonton Obesity Staging System Severity and 90-Day Postoperative Complications After Primary Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13323407.creator: Anna Carolina Batista Dantas, Denis Pajecki, Priscila Caproni, Beatriz Helena Tess, Marco Aurelio Santo
pmc-13323407.description: IntroductionObesity is a chronic multifactorial disease, and the Edmonton Obesity Staging System (EOSS) has been proposed as a tool to grade disease severity and estimate perioperative risk in patients undergoing metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS). However, its association with postoperative complications in those with more advanced stages of obesity remains insufficiently explored.

pmc-13391402.title: Grandparental childcare and physical activity among rural older adults in China: evidence from the China longitudinal aging social survey
pmc-13391402.creator: Daiming Li, Xiaoyun Chang, Aidi Liao
pmc-13391402.description: BackgroundPopulation aging in rural China is increasing, making the promotion of health among rural older adults an urgent issue. Physical activity is a crucial way to maintain health in later life and has attracted significant attention from researchers both domestically and internationally.

pmc-13462539.title: A dataset of neural network architectures generated via large language models
pmc-13462539.creator: Nadia Daoudi, Jordi Cabot
pmc-13462539.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Neural networks are increasingly used to support decision-making. To verify their reliability and adaptability, researchers and practitioners have proposed a variety of tools and methods for tasks such as NN code verification, refactoring, and migration. These tools play a crucial role in guaranteeing both the correctness and maintainability of neural network architectures, helping to prevent implementation errors, simplify model updates, and ensure that complex networks can be reliably extended and reused.

pmc-13510836.title: Phthalates and Alternative Plasticizers in Female Reproductive Health and Pregnancy: From Epidemiological Evidence to Nuclear Receptor-Mediated Mechanisms: A State-of-the-Art Review
pmc-13510836.creator: Audrey Antoine, Coline Charnay, Denis Gallot, Régine Quinard, Geoffroy Marceau, Corinne Belville, Lauren S. Richardson, Loïc Blanchon, Ramkumar Menon, Vincent Sapin

pmc-13680582.title: Awareness and perception of postpartum depression among rural Indian mothers
pmc-13680582.creator: Seema Hemendra Satbhai, Shamim Mohammad
pmc-13680582.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Postpartum depression (PPD) is a major yet neglected public health concern that affects maternal and child health outcomes. Awareness of PPD is crucial for early detection and timely help-seeking; however, community-level awareness remains limited in India. This cross-sectional study assessed awareness of PPD and attitudes towards help-seeking behaviour related to PPD among postpartum mothers in rural Pune using a structured questionnaire.
